packageRules.description: Runtime dependencies are bumped by hand: OpenVINO and the export extra's transformers<5.4 cap have each broken the NPU path on a version change, which no CI runner can catch. See CLAUDE.md and the deps-canary workflow.
Dev tooling (the dev dependency group, the only one) is safe to keep current: none of it ships to users.
Auto-merge only dev tooling, and only once a release has been public for a week, so a compromised or yanked version has time to be noticed first.
Always a human review: crates are compiled into the released overlay binary, and actions run with the release job's PyPI and repo-write tokens.
